PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.

2. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

3. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.

7. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

8. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.

9. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

11. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.

12. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Free-hand sketching and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain ICT Tools in Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
